um assistente de IA que trabalha para a: an AI assistant that works for the company: answers customers, schedules appointments, organizes requests. At a clinic, it helps patients on WhatsApp; at an office, it reminds clients about deadlines.

o documento que diz para que o agente ex: the document that says why the agent exists, what matters most, what it never does, and when it calls a person. Anthropic wrote one for Claude; in a clinic or office, it fits on one or two pages.

Nem tudo que o agente sabe fazer ele dev: The agent shouldn’t do everything it knows how to do on its own. Giving the address has no risk. Waiving a fee affects the money coming in. This lesson helps you decide, action by action, how far it can go.
